criteria.label: Non-interactive JSON CLI
criteria.description: Commands avoid interactive prompts/browsers and return structured JSON output and errors.

criteria.label: Official MCP server
criteria.description: First-party hosted or official documented Model Context Protocol server for agent tools.

criteria.label: Scoped agent identity
criteria.description: Dedicated agent identity or fine-grained service identity separate from personal user logins.

criteria.label: Pre-mutation cost preview
criteria.description: Dry-run cost estimate and budget check returned before applying scaling or compute mutations.

criteria.label: Human approval gate on mutations
criteria.description: Platform pauses destructive/production mutations until a human approves out of band.

criteria.label: Non-code mutation undo
criteria.description: Reversible undo and audit log for platform mutations outside Git (env vars, scaling, crons, domains).

criteria.label: Default canary with auto-rollback
criteria.description: Gradual percentage traffic shift on by default that rolls back automatically on elevated 5xx errors.

criteria.label: Code + Postgres rollback together
criteria.description: Coordinated rollback of application code and managed PostgreSQL together to a release point in time.
